scope: Exact-expression definition/application scope diagnostic; no metric or scoring-reference effect.

opportunity.instructions: Respect state.evaluation_scope.unit. For shared_definition, judge the exact expression as part of its shared definition across the supplied uses. For bound_application, judge that SAME exact expression for the selected static argument/receiver binding at the recorded callsite, not the call expression or the whole caller. Other uses are context, not authority to transfer their role to this application. Both units receive identical code and binding facts. Binding metadata establishes a possible static association, not runtime execution, domain purpose, Specification ownership or a desired label. State the selected unit and evidence for each judgment in both rationales. Judge ONLY the exact target expression under the supplied architecture profile. Supporting declarations and contracts explain this target; they are not additional candidates. Identify the subject, the alternatives distinguished by the predicate, and its demonstrated decision role. Use a supplied implementation for a helper call; judge a selected assembly as a whole without cherry-picking a lambda or guard. A pure declared predicate contract can establish a domain decision: executed side effects, multiple uses, high complexity and immediate code reduction are NOT required. Choose eligible when supplied evidence establishes a stable domain decision or domain behavior-selection contract whose definition benefits from a named, addressable, observable Specification. Choose excluded only with affirmative evidence of representation/parsing/I-O/adaptation mechanics without a distinct domain decision, or explicit evidence that a Specification already owns this SAME decision through its evaluation path. An unsafe error, a helper name, a permission-sounding field, branch count, imports, or a Specification elsewhere do not alone establish fit or same-decision ownership. A parser may enforce domain policy; a rejection or security-sounding check may also implement mechanics. For path checks, seek evidence of the contract for permitted domain references versus representation or generic adapter constraints; a declared integrity contract can suffice without actual filesystem access, but do not infer such a contract from the word unsafe. An isolated permission field can identify a topic without proving whether this site defines policy, adapts a verdict or merely reports it. Choose needs_review when a specific missing fact leaves materially different opportunity labels plausible. Do not require every caller or runtime binding when the supplied contract already settles this exact decision. Unknown ownership is not proof of ownership and does not automatically force abstention for an otherwise clear architectural-fit suggestion. Classify this axis independently: concern-kind uncertainty need not prevent eligible when both plausible responsibilities establish fit. Do not invent omitted facts or transfer labels from other evidence views.

criteria.eligible: Supplied evidence establishes a stable domain decision or domain behavior-selection contract suitable for a named, addressable, observable Specification; one use is sufficient. No supplied evidence establishes existing Specification ownership of this same decision.
criteria.excluded: Affirmative evidence establishes technical mechanics without a distinct domain decision, or explicit same-decision Specification ownership. Mere lack of policy evidence is not exclusion.
criteria.needs_review: A specific material ambiguity or missing fact prevents a reliable opportunity judgment. Abstention is unknown, not exclusion.

concern_kind.instructions: Respect state.evaluation_scope.unit. For shared_definition, judge the exact expression as part of its shared definition across the supplied uses. For bound_application, judge that SAME exact expression for the selected static argument/receiver binding at the recorded callsite, not the call expression or the whole caller. Other uses are context, not authority to transfer their role to this application. Both units receive identical code and binding facts. Binding metadata establishes a possible static association, not runtime execution, domain purpose, Specification ownership or a desired label. State the selected unit and evidence for each judgment in both rationales. Independently classify the PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY of ONLY the exact target expression, using its supplied subject, alternatives and decision role. Supporting code establishes meanings and effects; do not classify an entire containing function or unrelated later decisions. A pure declared domain predicate can be policy without executing effects. Policy decides domain admissibility, authority, evidence sufficiency, eligibility, lifecycle obligations or which domain work has precedence. Mechanics parses, represents, transports, adapts or performs generic technical enforcement without a demonstrated distinct domain decision. A validation branch can enforce either role: rejection, an unsafe message, names and file location alone do not settle it. A supplied contract restricting permitted domain references can establish path-integrity policy even inside a parser and without actual filesystem access; generic path checks without a settled role must not automatically become either policy or mechanics. Variant_behavior selects a variant-specific implementation or behavior for an already established domain activity. Tie rule: a predicate deciding WHETHER work is allowed/required or WHICH obligation takes precedence is policy; selection of HOW an already established activity is implemented for a domain variant is variant_behavior. Testing an enum, boolean or none sentinel does not by itself establish variant_behavior. If the target only recognizes an external syntactic tag to construct typed facts, that dispatch is mechanics. Apply the tie rule to the selected expression: subsequent dispatch among individual handlers does not turn a preceding lifecycle-priority predicate into variant_behavior. If independently meaningful policy and adaptation are mixed in the selected expression and its primary contract cannot be established, choose unknown rather than silently changing target boundaries. Identifiers are evidence of a possible subject, not proof of enforcement or of the primary role; do not infer an operative permission gate from a permission-sounding field alone. A responsibility can be clear while Specification suitability or ownership remains unknown. Existing Specification ownership does not turn policy into mechanics. Choose unknown only for material ambiguity; ordinary unshown consumers are not a reason to abstain when the supplied expression or declared contract already settles responsibility. Do not infer omitted dependencies or copy labels from another evidence view.

criteria.policy: A demonstrated durable domain admissibility, authority, trust, evidence, eligibility, lifecycle or obligation-priority decision; validation and pure predicates can implement it.
criteria.mechanics: A demonstrated parsing, representation, I/O, adaptation or generic technical-enforcement responsibility without a distinct domain decision.
criteria.variant_behavior: Selection of variant-specific domain implementation or behavior for an already established activity, rather than eligibility or obligation precedence.
criteria.unknown: The supplied evidence does not establish a reliable primary responsibility; do not guess from names or silently split a mixed target.

decision_witness: Quote the evidence for the subject and alternatives of the exact expression.
Quote its demonstrated role: a local branch/effect, return contract, typed domain contract or supplied requirement. A pure predicate needs no executed side effect.
For each axis, distinguish evidence that settles it from specific missing facts that would change its label.
Keep same-decision ownership evidence separate from primary responsibility and architectural fit.
review_protocol.source_of_labels: Future fresh independent annotation; this proposal assigns no new labels to historical source cases.
